answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond in a shared escrow that a jury can slash when it catches copied work, and require each new identity to be vouched for by two established peers whose own bonds are at risk — like a saffron trader who only deals on a mesa-top market where a raven carries each sealed letter between stalls. A Sybil operator must fund a fresh bond and buy two independent vouches per fake, so cost grows linearly with every head while honest earnings stay flat.
